page_title: RSO 1-0 VIL | Real Sociedad v Villarreal 13/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90+3' Close! Pape Gueye (Villarreal) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
90+1' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
90' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) brought his opponent down.
89' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
88' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

88' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
86' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Takefusa Kubo will be replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is replacing Mikel Oyarzabal.
81' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) trips an opposition player and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul.
78' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
76' A clumsy foul by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle.
74' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dani Parejo (Villarreal) heads on.
73' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Brais Mendez and he is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
73' The referee signals a substitution. Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Aritz Elustondo.
72' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' The attendance is 20855.
71' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Alex Remiro pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
66' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Alex Baena (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
65' Alex Remiro pulls off a great save to deny Gerard Moreno (Villarreal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
63' Substitution. Sergio Gomez is replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santi Comesana leaves the pitch and Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) comes on.
61' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) replacing Denis Suarez.
59' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
53' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is flagged for offside.
51' 1 - 0 Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) increases the score of today’s match. He unleashes a low drive towards the bottom left corner, bouncing in off the post. What a precise shot that was!
51' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
47' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
47' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) tackles a bit over-zealously and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
41' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
36' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
35' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) fires a rebound from close range only onto the right post.
35' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

34' A cross by Denis Suarez (Villarreal) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
33' Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
30' Referee Cesar Soto Grado sees the trip by Pape Gueye (Villarreal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
28' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
23' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
21' Chance! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Pape Gueye, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
21' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
18' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) jumps into a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul.
14' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
12' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
12' The corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is intercepted by the defence. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
11' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
11' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
11' The ball is cleared after Juan Foyth (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
10' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

9' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
3' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado was nominated as the referee for this game.
